faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our Vedic consultations, birth charts, remedies, and privacy guidelines.

list.q: What details do I need to provide for a horoscope reading?
list.a: To perform an accurate Vedic analysis, you need to provide your exact Date of Birth, exact Time of Birth (with AM/PM), and Place of Birth. If your birth time is approximate, please inform us in advance so we can run calculations to verify your ascendant degree.

list.q: How accurate are the predictions and suggestions?
list.a: Vedic astrology (Jyotish) is a mathematical science of planetary coordinates and Dasha (timeline) periods. While horoscope readings outline the cosmic tendencies and periods of opportunity or caution, classical remedies are suggested to neutralize malefic configurations and empower favorable ones.

list.q: What is the significance of Maa Baglamukhi in the remedies?
list.a: Maa Baglamukhi is one of the ten great Mahavidyas representing victory, protection, and the subduing of obstacles, legal problems, and negative forces. Pandit Sanjay Uniyal specializes in Maa Baglamukhi sadhanas, prescribing powerful, protective mantras and rituals to clear severe life blockages.

list.q: Can I book an online session or do I need to visit in person?
list.a: We offer full flexibility. You can book an online consultation via Google Meet, Zoom, or WhatsApp video call, which is highly detailed and includes digital sharing of your birth chart. Alternatively, you can book an in-person, face-to-face consultation at our center.

list.q: Are the suggested remedies expensive or complex to perform?
list.a: No. Pandit ji focuses on practical, authentic Vedic remedies. Most remedies include chanting specific mantras, planetary donations (Daan), fasting on certain days, or setting up small elements to balance home energy. Gemstones are optional and suggested only if planetary strength is highly deficient.

list.q: How is the confidentiality of my consultation maintained?
list.a: Your trust is our highest priority. All personal questions, financial struggles, family disputes, birth chart data, and conversation details are kept strictly confidential. No information is stored on public servers or shared with any third parties under any circumstances.
